label: late copy-phase positions (recall index >= 4)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during the original tokens or on <DEL>) and essentially only from recall index 2 onward, and mostly from 4 onward. The firing rate goes up with position: 2% at recall_idx 2, 25-36% at 4-7, 68% at 8. The largest activations are on the last one or two outputs of long sequences (L=9 holds 55% of the mass; t=16-17 hold 37%). Within those late steps it is sparse (precision about 0.31). Which late steps fire depends on token content that no single token variable captures (out_tok lift is only about 2-3.6x, highest for j, 3, 2, h). The predicate catches about 85% of activations and 90% of activation mass. It does not fire on the first two copy outputs or in sequences shorter than 6 beyond a small rate.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: 2, r, j, i, p, k; least: v, c, q, <DEL>) and the token being output, by phase (copy phase: j, 2, 3, c; input phase: ; delimiter step: ); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=5, phase=2, L=4 & t=6.
